args.subject: Group Booking Availability for 10 People - June 2024
args.body:
Dear City Hub Tokyo Group Bookings Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am organising a group stay at City Hub Tokyo and would like to enquire about availability for a group of 10 people in June 2024.

Could you please let me know:
- Whether you have availability for 10 guests in June 2024
- The dates you would be able to accommodate
- Group rates and any booking conditions or deadlines for group reservations
- Whether group bookings include any additional services (such as breakfast, meeting space, or airport transfers)

I would be happy to provide further details on our preferred dates and requirements once you confirm initial availability.

Thank you for your assistance. I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
Email: emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
Phone: 327-420-4923
